blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Critic-free methods are widely used in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) for long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, avoiding difficult and costly critic training. Common alternatives lack token-level credit assignment and typically rely on grouped rollouts to estimate prompt-specific baselines. A critic can address both limitations, but long-CoT critic training is hindered by insufficient coverage of trajectories with diverse lengths and early gradients dominated by the newly initialized value head. We introduce S3AC (Stabilized, Selective, and Scalable Actor-Critic) for LLM reasoning, built around a practical critic-training recipe. The trained critic provides token-specific advantages and prompt-specific baselines. Using the prompt-level baseline to estimate difficulty, we propose Difficulty-Aware Prompt Sampling (DAPS). DAPS combines this estimate with outcome history to select prompts before generation, reducing rollout waste without offline difficulty initialization. S3AC improves group-rollout performance across dense and mixture-of-experts models from 1.5B to 397B parameters, outperforming a modern GRPO variant (GRPO-X). At 35B, it sustains single-rollout training while tested critic-free baselines deteriorate after initial gains.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Critic-free methods, including GRPO, are widely used in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) for large language model (LLM) reasoning ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ; Kimi Team, 2026a ; Kimi Team, 2026b ; LLM-Core Xiaomi, 2026 ; Intern-S2-Preview Team, 2026 ) .
They avoid the difficulty and cost of training a value model for long responses under sparse rewards and an evolving policy.
However, replacing the critic with reward statistics limits how learning signals distinguish prompts and reasoning steps.
blocks.zh:
包括GRPO在内的无批评方法被广泛用于对大语言模型(LLM)推理(Deep Seek-AI,2026;Kimi Team,2026a;Kimi Team,2026b;LLM-Core Xiaomi,2026;Intern-S2-Preview Team,2026)进行可核查奖励的强化学习(RLVR).
它们避免了在微薄的奖励和不断演变的政策下培训长期反应的价值模式的困难和成本。
然而,用奖励统计来取而代之的批评者限制了学习信号如何区分提示和推理步骤.

blocks.en:
A failure may be expected on a difficult prompt but surprising on an easy one, motivating a prompt-specific baseline.
GRPO estimates this baseline from grouped rollouts, requiring each group to wait for its slowest response ( Xu and Ding, 2026 ; Hou et al., 2026 ) .
Common single-rollout alternatives, including REINFORCE++ ( Hu et al., 2025 ) and FlashREINFORCE ( Hu et al., 2026 ) , use batch statistics instead.
These shared baselines do not account for differences in prompt difficulty.
blocks.zh:
可以预期,在困难的瞬间发生失败,但在容易发生的情况下却令人惊讶,这将促使制定迅速的具体基线。
GRPO通过分组推出来估计这一基准,要求每个组等待最慢的反应(徐和丁,2026;Hou等,2026.).
常用的单卷替代品,包括REINFORCE++(Hu等,2025年)和FlashREINFORCE(Hu等,2026年),取而代之的是批量统计.
这些共同基准并不说明在快速困难方面的差异。

blocks.en:
Even with a prompt-specific baseline, a single response-level advantage cannot distinguish the contributions of individual tokens.
When an answer is incorrect, useful intermediate reasoning can receive the same negative signal as steps that lead away from a solution ( Wu et al., 2026 ) .
This scalar signal does not reflect how the difficulty of reaching a correct answer changes as reasoning progresses.
blocks.zh:
即使有一个迅速具体的基线,单一的响应级别优势也无法区分单个信号的贡献.
当一个答案不正确时,有用的中间推理可以收到与导致脱离一个解决方案的步骤相同的负面信号(Wu等,2026.).
这种分级信号并不反映如何随着推理的进步而改变如何难以达成正确的答案.

blocks.en:
A learned critic offers a common route to addressing both limitations: a prompt-conditioned baseline without grouped rollouts and token-specific learning signals throughout the response ( Sutton et al., 1999 ) .
However, learning reliable value estimates for long reasoning trajectories remains challenging.
Our analysis highlights two obstacles to effective value learning: initial-policy trajectories provide limited supervision on long, correct responses, while early gradients can be dominated by the newly initialized value head.
blocks.zh:
一位有学问的批评家为解决这两个限制因素提供了一条共同的道路:一个没有分组的快速条件基线,以及在整个反应过程中的具体符号学习信号(Sutton等人,1999年)。
然而,学习长期推理轨迹的可靠价值估计仍然具有挑战性。
我们的分析突出了有效价值学习的两个障碍:初始政策轨迹对长而正确的反应提供有限的监督,而早期梯度可以被新初始化的价值头所支配.

blocks.en:
To address these obstacles, we introduce S3AC (Stabilized, Selective, and Scalable Actor–Critic) for LLM reasoning (Figure 1 ).
We pretrain the critic on trajectories from policies of different strengths to broaden coverage across response lengths and outcomes.
Small-scale value-head initialization controls initial predictions, while a larger gradient-clipping threshold reduces excessive rescaling of backbone updates by head-dominated gradients.
Updated online, the critic provides difficulty-aware, token-specific advantages throughout the response through generalized advantage estimation ( Schulman et al., 2016 ) .
blocks.zh:
为了克服这些障碍,我们引入了S3AC(稳定、选择和可扩展的演员-批评)用于LLM推理(图1)。
我们从不同强项的政策出发,对批评者进行轨迹培训,以扩大反应长度和结果的覆盖面。
小规模的值头初始化控制了初始预测,而更大的梯度剪接阈值会用由头为主的梯度来减少主干线更新的过度再缩放.
在网络上更新后,评论家通过普惠性优势估计,在整个回应中提供了意向性,象征性的具体优势(Schulman等,2016年).

blocks.en:
The critic’s usefulness extends to deciding what to generate.
Because its prompt-conditioned estimate is available before rollout, it can guide prompt selection as well as policy learning.
We propose Difficulty-Aware Prompt Sampling (DAPS), which combines this estimate with outcome history to select prompts of intermediate estimated difficulty.
Some existing selectors require offline-initialized statistics or an auxiliary value model ( Xu and Ding, 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ) ; DAPS reuses the critic already trained for policy learning.
blocks.zh:
评论家的用处延伸到决定产生什么。
由于在推出之前可以提供其迅速的有条件的估计,它可以指导及时的选择和政策学习。
我们提议采用困难-智能即时抽样法(DAPS),将这一估计与结果历史相结合,选择中间估计困难的提示。
一些已存在的选取者需要离线初始化的统计数据或辅助值模型(徐和丁,2026;高出等,2026;DAPS再用已经受过政策学习训练的批评者.

blocks.en:
We evaluate two dense and two multimodal mixture-of-experts models spanning 1.5B to 397B parameters.
Under group rollout, actor–critic training improves average performance across all four models, outperforming GRPO-X on all seven evaluated benchmarks at 35B and all five at 397B.
At 35B, it sustains single-rollout performance while the tested critic-free baselines decline after initial gains (Figure 4 ).
DAPS further improves both rollout settings over uniform prompt sampling and reduces trajectories discarded by group filtering.
blocks.zh:
我们评价两种密集和两种多模式的专家混合模型,涵盖1.5B至397B参数。
在团体推广下,演员-批评培训提高了所有四个模式的平均业绩,在35B的所有七个评价基准上都超过了GPRO-X,在397B的所有五个基准上都超过了GPRO-X。
在35B时,它保持了单滚性能,而被测试的无批评者基线在初始收益后会下降(图4 .
DAPS进一步改进了在统一即时采样之上的推出设置,并减少了通过分组过滤而丢弃的轨迹.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
PPO ( Schulman et al., 2017 ) uses a learned critic with GAE ( Schulman et al., 2016 ) to estimate advantages for policy optimization.
For long-CoT reasoning, VC-PPO ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) pretrains the value model and decouples the GAE parameters of the actor and critic, while VAPO ( Yue et al., 2025b ) adapts λ \lambda to response length.
VinePPO ( Kazemnejad et al., 2025 ) , EVPO ( Pan et al., 2026 ) , and AsyPPO ( Liu et al., 2026 ) improve value estimates through Monte Carlo rollouts, explained-variance gating, and critic ensembles, respectively.
SAO ( Hou et al., 2026 ) and CompactionRL ( Li et al., 2026 ) apply PPO to single-rollout training of large MoE models.
While these methods address different aspects of actor–critic training, our work brings critic initialization, online value learning, and critic-guided prompt selection together in a unified framework.
Our study combines targeted diagnostics and ablations with evaluations across rollout settings and model scales, including group-rollout training at 397B parameters.
blocks.zh:
PPO(Schulman等,2017年)使用GAE(Schulman等,2016年)的有学问的批评家来估计政策优化的优势.
对于Long-CoT推理,VC-PPO(Yuan等,2025年)预示了演员和评论家的GAE参数值模型并脱钩,而VAPO(Yue等,2025年b)则将QQ\lambda适应响应长度.
视频 (Kazemnejad等,2025年),EVPO(Pan等,2026年)和AsyPPO(Liu等,2026年)分别通过蒙特卡洛推出,解释-变格和评论类综艺节目来改进价值估计.
SAO(Hou等,2026年)和CompactionRL(Li等,2026年)将PPO应用于大型MOE模型的单滚出训练.
虽然这些方法解决了演员-批评培训的不同方面,但我们的作品带来了批评者初始化,在线价值学习,以及评论者指导的快速选择在一个统一的框架中共同进行。
我们的研究将目标明确的诊断和模拟与各种推出环境和模型尺度的评价相结合,包括397B参数的团体推出培训。

blocks.en:
Group-based methods such as GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) , RLOO ( Ahmadian et al., 2024 ) , and DAPO ( Yu et al., 2025 ) derive baselines from multiple responses to the same prompt.
Single-rollout methods use batch statistics (REINFORCE++; Hu et al., 2025 ), add a sequence-level trust region to a batch-mean baseline (FlashREINFORCE; Hu et al., 2026 ), or track per-prompt values with a tabular estimator (SPO; Xu and Ding, 2026 ).
These methods typically construct advantages from sequence-level reward statistics without learning a value function over intermediate response prefixes.
blocks.zh:
GRPO(Shao等人,2024年),RLOO(Ahmadian等人,2024年),DAPO(Yu等人,2025年)等基于集团的方法,从对同一快件的多回响应中得出了基线.
单排出法采用批量统计法(REINFORCE+;Hu等,2025年),将序列级信任区加入批量正数基线(FlashREINFORCE;Hu等,2026年),或用表格估计器跟踪每时速值(SPO;Xu和Ding,2026年)。
这些方法通常从序列级的奖励统计中构建优势,而不学习一个值函数而不是中间响应前缀.

blocks.en:
Dynamic sampling ( Yu et al., 2025 ) requires multiple responses per prompt and discards responses from uninformative groups after generation.
Other methods estimate difficulty before rollout from reward history (GRESO; Zheng et al., 2025 ), from a tracker initialized with offline rollouts (SPO), or from a separately trained prompt-level value model (PCL; Gao et al., 2026 ).
DAPS combines pass-rate history with value estimates from the existing S3AC critic, avoiding a separately trained difficulty model and supporting both group and single rollout.
blocks.zh:
动态采样(Yu等,2025年)要求每个即时反应的多分响应,而非信息化组群的再生成反应会丢弃.
其他方法从奖励历史(GRESO;Zheng等,2025年),从离线推出的跟踪器(SPO),或从经过单独培训的即时值模型(PCL;Gao等,2026年)中估算推出前的困难。
DAPS将传入率历史与现有的S3AC评论家给出的价值估计相结合,避免了单独训练出难度模型,支持分组和单项推出.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
S3AC is an actor–critic framework for long-CoT RLVR that trains a value model for both policy learning and prompt selection (Figure 1 ).
The critic provides prompt-conditioned baselines and token-specific advantages, while its initial-state value guides prompt sampling before generation.
We first formulate the actor–critic update (§ 3.1 ), then examine the critic’s role under group and single rollout (§ 3.2 ), describe its training recipe (§ 3.3 ), and introduce DAPS (§ 3.4 ).

blocks.en: 3.2 How the Critic Shapes Learning Signals
blocks.zh: 3.2 批评形状如何学习信号

blocks.en:
We examine how the critic shapes learning signals across prompts of different difficulty and across positions within a response.
The initial critic value V ϕ ​ ( s 0 ) V_{\phi}(s_{0}) estimates the policy’s expected return for a prompt before generation.
Figure 2 a plots these values against mean Monte Carlo (MC) returns from independent rollouts, using a frozen 35B actor–critic pair with one point per prompt.
The values track differences in empirical returns, supporting their use as prompt-specific baselines.
The prompt-specific baseline is not limited to the initial position: subsequent values remain conditioned on the prompt throughout the response.
Figure 2 b illustrates this distinction in long failed responses: although all receive the same terminal reward of − 1 -1 , their mean raw advantages remain close to zero for hard prompts and below − 1 -1 for easy prompts across response progress.

Within a response, expected returns can also change as reasoning progresses.
A shared response-level advantage cannot reflect these changes.
Figure 3 illustrates this behavior with a pretrained critic: its value rises when the response identifies candidate values and increases further when it determines the requested term.
GAE combines these evolving values with the observed reward to construct token-specific advantages, allowing different positions within a response to receive different learning signals.

GAE将这些不断演变的价值观和所观察到的奖励结合起来,构建出特定符号的优势,使响应中的不同位置能够接收不同的学习信号.

blocks.en:
Under group rollout, the group mean already provides a prompt-specific baseline, while the critic adds token-level advantages.
Under single rollout, it also supplies the prompt-specific baseline missing from batch statistics.
Our experiments show that S3AC outperforms GRPO-X under group rollout and sustains stable single-rollout training at 35B.
These benefits require informative values across prompts and response positions, motivating the critic-training recipe in § 3.3 .

在分组推出下,分组意味着已经提供了即时特定的基线,而评论家则增加了象征性级别优势.
在单一推出下,它还提供了批量统计中缺失的快速具体基线。
我们的实验显示,S3AC在集体推出下超越了GRPO-X,并在35B维持稳定的单推出训练.
这些好处要求各种提示和反应立场具有信息价值,从而激励第3.3节中的批评者培训方法。

blocks.en: 3.3 Training a Good Critic
blocks.zh: 3.3 培训好批评者

blocks.en:
We initialize the critic through value pretraining and then update it online as the policy evolves.
Our pretraining recipe addresses two challenges: limited coverage of long, correct trajectories and optimization dominated by the newly initialized value head.
blocks.zh:
并随政策的发展而在网上更新。
我们的预训方法处理两个挑战:对长而正确的轨迹的有限覆盖和由新初始化的价值头所主导的优化。

blocks.en:
VC-PPO ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) uses trajectories from a fixed initial policy, while SAO ( Hou et al., 2026 ) emphasizes larger pretraining corpora.
However, data scale alone does not ensure coverage of long, correct responses.
We pool trajectories from policies of different strengths to broaden coverage across response lengths and outcomes, improving early online value prediction and downstream learning progress in our comparison (§ 4.3 ).
We pretrain for two epochs with token-averaged MSE against terminal returns, freezing attention layers following SAO ( Hou et al., 2026 ) and additionally freezing the MoE router.
blocks.zh:
VC-PPO(Yuan等,2025年)使用固定起步政策的轨迹,而SAO(Hou等,2026年)则强调更大型的训练前蝎子.
然而,仅靠数据尺度并不能确保涵盖长期、正确的反应。
我们汇集了来自不同强项的政策的轨迹,以扩大反应长度和结果的覆盖面,改进早期在线价值预测和下游学习进展的比较(第4.3节)。
我们为两个时代预作训练,以象征性平均MSE对抗终端返回,在SAO之后冻结关注层(Hou等,2026年),并额外冻结MOE路由器.

blocks.en: 3.4 Difficulty-Aware Prompt Sampling
blocks.zh: 3.4 难以识别的快速取样

blocks.en:
The same critic can also help decide which prompts the actor should attempt.
In our group-rollout experiments, DAPO-style dynamic sampling ( Yu et al., 2025 ) improves S3AC over retaining all groups, but it discards groups only after their responses have been generated.
We therefore propose Difficulty-Aware Prompt Sampling (DAPS), which combines the initial critic value with outcome history to guide prompt selection before generation.

在我们的分组推出实验中,DAPO风格的动态采样(Yu等人,2025年)改进了S3AC,而不是保留所有组,但只有在组群的响应产生后才会丢弃.
因此,我们提议采用“困难-智能即时抽样”(DAPS),将最初的批评价值与结果历史结合起来,以指导一代人之前的即时选择。

S3AC uses DAPS on Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, R1-Distill-1.5B, and Intern-S2-Preview-35B, and uniform sampling on Intern-S2-397B.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: We evaluate the complete S3AC recipe under group and single rollout with benchmark performance and training stability.
blocks.zh: 我们评价S3AC的完整配方在分组和单一推出下具有基准性能和培训稳定性。

blocks.en:
Even when grouped responses already provide a prompt-specific baseline, S3AC improves over GRPO-X (§ 4.1 ; Tables 3 – 3 ).
At 35B, the best-checkpoint average increases from 76.4 to 80.5, with gains on all seven benchmarks.
These gains extend to 397B, where S3AC raises the average from 85.1 to 87.3 and leads on all five benchmarks.
Together with gains on both 1.5B models, this supports S3AC’s scalability from 1.5B dense models to 397B MoE models.
The gains are consistent with § 3.2 : beyond the prompt-level information captured by group rewards, the critic conditions on the evolving response prefix and provides different learning signals across token positions.
blocks.zh:
即使分组答复已经提供了迅速具体的基准,S3AC也比GRPO-X有所改进(§ 4.1;表3-3)。
在35B时,最高检查点平均数从76.4个增加到80.5个,这七个基准都有所收获。
这些收益已扩大到397B,S3AC将平均数从85.1提高到87.3,并领导所有五个基准。
加上对两个1.5B模型的增益,这支持了S3AC的可扩展性,从1.5B密集模型到397B MoE模型.
收益与第3.2节一致:除了团体奖励所获取的即时信息外,批评者还在不断变化的响应前缀上附加条件,并在各个象征性位置上提供不同的学习信号.

blocks.en:
With one response per prompt, S3AC achieves scores comparable to its group-rollout results (Tables 3 and 3 ).
On Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B and 35B, its advantage over the best critic-free baseline within each setting is larger under single rollout.
At 35B, S3AC reaches 80.9 versus 70.4 for REINFORCE++, a 10.5-point gain.
This pattern is consistent with the critic supplying the prompt-specific baseline missing from batch-level reward statistics, alongside token-specific advantages (§ 3.2 ).
Figure 2 illustrates this distinction: despite identical terminal rewards, long failed responses receive mean advantages closer to zero for hard prompts and more negative for easy prompts.

The full 35B training curves show sustained single-rollout learning (Figure 4 a).
Both critic-free baselines improve initially but then decline, while S3AC retains most of its gains through 1,600 gradient steps.
REINFORCE++ exhibits rapid growth in rollout entropy and response length, whereas FlashREINFORCE shifts toward shorter responses as its score declines (Figure 4 b,c).
These dynamics support S3AC’s stabilized actor–critic design for sustained single-rollout training at 35B.
Appendix B provides full 35B benchmark curves, Qwen single-rollout dynamics, and training and evaluation statistics (Figures 8 – 9 ; Table 7 ).
Stable 35B single-rollout training also extends to alternative policy losses (Table 8 ).

blocks.en: 4.3 Analysis of Critic Pretraining
blocks.zh: 4.3 批判性先行性分析

blocks.en: We examine the proposed value-pretraining method of § 3.3 on Intern-S2-Preview-35B; full setups and diagnostics are in Appendix C .

blocks.en:
Pretraining on trajectories from multiple policies yields a more accurate critic early in online training.
The motivation is limited coverage: among responses longer than 24K tokens, only 5.0% are correct in initial-policy samples, compared with 61.8% for the policy at gradient step 1,600 (Figure 10 a,b).
We compare a coverage critic , pretrained on trajectories from policies of different strengths, with an on-policy critic , pretrained only on initial-policy trajectories.
Both runs share the actor initialization and the online recipe under group rollout; the two recipes also differ in data amount (Appendix C.1 ).
The coverage critic attains higher EV and lower value loss early in online training, and the gap narrows as the on-policy critic adapts online (Figure 5 ).
In this comparison, coverage pretraining enables faster learning progress and higher final performance within the same actor-update budget.

Consistent with the analysis in § 3.3 , the value head accounts for over 99% of the squared gradient norm during the first 10 critic updates on Intern-S2-Preview-35B, despite having only 2,048 parameters (Appendix C.3 ).

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
S3AC enables effective critic training for long-CoT RLVR through broader trajectory coverage, small-scale value-head initialization, and relaxed critic gradient clipping.
The trained critic provides prompt-specific baselines and token-level advantages.
Experiments show that this actor–critic approach outperforms GRPO-X under group rollout across 1.5B–397B models and sustains stable single-rollout training at 35B.
Beyond policy learning, DAPS reuses critic values and outcome history to select prompts before generation, reducing discarded responses under group rollout and improving performance in both settings.
blocks.zh:
S3AC通过更广泛的轨迹覆盖范围、小规模价值头初始化和放松批评者梯度剪接,为长COT RLVR提供有效的批评者培训。
训练有素的批评家提供了迅速具体的基线和象征性的优势.
实验显示,这一演员-批评方法在1.5B-397B模式下超越了GRPO-X,并在35B持续进行稳定的单发培训.
除了政策学习外,DAPS还重新利用批评家的价值观和结果历史,在一代人之前选择提示,减少在群体推出时被丢弃的反应,并改进两种情况下的性能.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
All experiments are reasoning-style tasks with verifiable rewards, namely math, science and multimodal reasoning.
We do not evaluate agentic multi-turn settings, where credit must be assigned across tool calls and environment turns, so whether our findings carry over to agentic RL remains open.
The reported experiments do not systematically assess variability across independent RL training seeds.
blocks.zh:
所有实验都是推理式的任务,具有可核查的回报,即数学,科学和多模式推理.
我们不评估代理性多回合设置,即必须在工具呼叫和环境转换之间分配信用,因此,我们的结论是否继续延伸到代理性RL。
所报告的实验没有系统地评估独立RL培训种子的可变性。

blocks.en: S3AC costs 27–40% more amortized wall time per actor gradient step than GRPO-X , because the critic must be trained and run for inference alongside the policy.
blocks.zh: S3AC每个演员梯度步骤的摊还时间比GRPO-X要多27-40%,因为批评者必须接受培训,并和政策一起进行推论。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en:
Our work aims to improve long-CoT reasoning in LLMs through RLVR.
Higher benchmark scores do not establish the safety or reliability of model outputs in real-world applications; models may still generate incorrect or harmful content.
Deployment requires application-specific evaluation and safeguards.
Large-scale actor–critic training also requires additional computational resources and energy, and these costs should be weighed against the observed performance gains.
blocks.zh:
我们的工作目的是通过减少危险措施改进LLVMs中的长期CoT推理。
更高的基准分数并不能确定模型输出在现实世界应用中的安全性或可靠性;模型仍然可能产生不正确或有害的内容.
部署需要针对具体应用的评估和保障措施。
大规模的行为者-批评培训也需要额外的计算资源和能量,这些费用应与观察到的业绩收益权衡。

For Intern-S2-Preview-35B, the coverage critic learns from trajectories generated by policies of different strengths across multiple stages of prior experiments.

blocks.en: D.1 Experimental Setup

blocks.en:
We use the S3AC recipe in Appendix A with matched actor and critic initialization within each pair; the 35B runs use the coverage critic from Appendix C.1 .
Table 9 lists prompt batch sizes and acceptance floors.
All settings use n c = 3 n_{c}=3 and a count-decay factor of 0.99 per rollout batch (eight actor gradient steps).
At initialization, 40 gradient steps of uniform sampling precede an 80-gradient-step acceptance ramp.
We rescore prefetched prompts after the critic is trained on each rollout batch, using a window twice the previous candidate count.
